newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean basis steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean basis steady.

text.p: FOB grain and soybean basis values were steady on Tuesday in quiet dealings with little export news reported, brokers said.
"It's just dead quiet," one source said. "I should go on vacation for four months."

Brokers noted ample world feed grain supplies as a primary cause of the slow movement. They noted Egypt had turned elsewhere for its latest wheat purchases, underscoring the idea that U.S. wheat was overpriced.
Corn and soybean movement was steady with brokers noting sufficient supply in the pipeline.
"The farmer may be holding on to (new crop supplies) but it's still finding it's way down here," one broker said.
